response_args.floor_justification: Stable day with calm weather forecast and no volatility or storm signals, maintaining baseline 25% floor.
response_args.reasoning: Position: surplus (14.6 MW). Dispatch ladder: serve load, sell/charge surplus. Under max_profit, selling to grid before charging is prioritized, but here total surplus (14.6 MW) is entirely absorbed by total maximum battery charge headroom (16.0 MW: 10 + 6). Thus, charging batteries (10 MW for battery_1, 4.6 MW for battery_2) stores all surplus at sell_price value. No market sale or curtailment needed. Golden rules 1-4 upheld. Cascade: max_profit prioritizes profit/stored energy value.
